newsitem.title: south korea: Seoul stocks end higher after labour unrest fizzles.
newsitem.headline: Seoul stocks end higher after labour unrest fizzles.

text.p: South Korean stocks closed sharply higher on Monday on hopes of a political solution to labour unrest after President Kim Young-sam's proposal to discuss the crisis with opposition leaders on Tuesday.

"Stock prices rose steadily even when strikes were rampant last week. Kim's offer to have talks with opposition leaders gave the market a big boost," said Kim Choon-kwon, a broker at Daewoo Securities.
The composite stock index closed up 24.23 points or 3.49 percent at 718.46. Brokers said rising fund inflows and falling interest rates also boosted buying sentiment.
